newsitem.title: GREECE: DEH CONNECTS FIRST OF TWO 15 MW HYDRO POWER UNITS.
newsitem.headline: DEH CONNECTS FIRST OF TWO 15 MW HYDRO POWER UNITS.

text.p: Greece's Public Power Corporation (DEH) added a new 15 MW hydroelectric unit to its national power grid, it said in a statement.

It is the first of two units comprising Pournari II, the second power station on Arahthos river near the city of Arta in western Greece. The second 15-MW unit of the Pournari II power plant will be operational in October 1997, it said.
The lake formed to power the plant also serves to control the flow of the Arahthos river and offers extended irrigation facilities to nearby regions, DEH said.

The area of Arta is rendered a very important energy point following the completion of two hydroelectric power plants at Pournari and the installation in Arta of the submarine power cable connecting Greece to Italy. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
